instructions_to_main_agent: Use a dark theme as the foundational layer (bg-neutral-950 or #0A0A0A).

For the tables, explicitly use a white background (bg-white) with dark text (text-neutral-900) to meet the user's specific request for 'hvite tabeller' against the dark background. Add a subtle shadow or a 1px border to make the table pop out from the dark background.
Use Dynasty 8 Red (e.g., #D32F2F) for primary actions, badges, and accents. Do not use generic blue or purple.

Implement Google Login for the initial auth screen. The login screen should feature the luxury real estate background image with a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60) to ensure the login form is legible.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a premium, clean look.
Data grids and admin panels should use a dense, strict hierarchy. Remove rounded corners (rounded-none) to lean into a sharp, professional Swiss/Brutalist luxury aesthetic.
Forms for registering sales should be highly organized using CSS Grid (bento style) and clearly sectioned.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, table rows) for testing.
